Hi Sarah / Matt —

Thanks again for the demo earlier — great conversation. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary:
- Goal: Run a short private pilot (VPC/on‑prem connector) to validate latency and infra fit for OptiData search workloads.
- Success criteria: 95th percentile latency under 200ms for interactive queries and a reproducible evaluation using your 10k sample prompts.

Proposed pilot plan (2–4 weeks):
1) Pre‑pilot checklist & infra verification (1 week) — confirm network egress rules, allowlist IPs, and assign an infra contact.
2) Pilot setup & baseline runs (1 week) — we deploy a dedicated pilot instance in your VPC and run the sample set.
3) Evaluation & next steps (1–2 weeks) — review results and discuss production path (Dedicated vs Private on‑prem).

Action items for OptiData:
- Please confirm pilot priority and an estimated kickoff week.
- Share the primary infra contact (name, role, email) and a point for procurement if needed.
- Quick answers to the attached checklist so Connor and I can size the environment.

Attachments: redwood-private-pilot-checklist.pdf (short infra questionnaire), proposed-pilot-sow.docx (draft SOW).

If it helps, I can send calendar options for a 30‑minute technical kickoff this week — suggested times below.

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 8/3 10:00–10:30
- Wed 8/4 14:00–14:30

Thanks — looking forward to getting something practical running.
